name: Guardian
note: Wargear prints "Shuriken Catapult or Shuriken Pistol and Guardian Chainsword", read as Shuriken Catapult, or Shuriken Pistol and Guardian Chainsword (a bundle). "Guardian Chainsword" is not in the Wargear catalogue. IoE prints no Influence for this Archetype. Also Apocrypha p.83.

abilities.name: Martial Citizenry
abilities.text: You are drilled in using basic Asuryani weaponry. When attacking whilst in cover, gain +Rank to the Rending rating of any SHURIKEN weapons. When attacking an enemy in cover, gain +Rank ED on any melee attacks.

name: Ranger
note: IoE prints no Influence for this Archetype. Also Core p.107.

abilities.name: From the Shadows
abilities.text: You are adept at exploiting any form of concealment. Whenever a Vision Penalty (Wrath & Glory page 191) or Cover (Wrath & Glory page 181) imposes a penalty on someone trying to attack or detect you, the penalty is increased by +Rank DN.

name: Dark Reaper
note: SKILLS prints "Intimidate 1"; transcribed as Intimidation. Also Apocrypha p.143.

abilities.name: Inescapable Accuracy
abilities.text: Your targeting systems and uncanny precision make it impossible for your victims to hide. When making a ranged attack, you may reduce the total DN penalties you suffer due to Long Range, Vision Penalties, and the target’s Cover by an amount equal to your Rank. When you Brace a Heavy Weapon, you may Aim as a Free Action.

name: Dire Avenger
note: Print error: the Suggested Attributes (2/3/5/3/2/2/2, 61 XP) and Suggested Skills XP (54) are exactly the Ranger's (p.23); the suggested Willpower 2 is below the Archetype's own Willpower 3. Also Apocrypha p.146.

abilities.name: Defence Tactics
abilities.text: You advance, take cover, and complete your objectives without ever interrupting rate of fire. You may make a ranged attack with a SHURIKEN as a Free Action, but cannot do so in the same Turn you use Combat Actions to make another ranged, melee, or Interaction Attack. You can use this ability up to Rank times per combat, and never more than once per Turn.

name: Fire Dragon

abilities.name: Assured Destruction
abilities.text: With intense heat you boil your targets from the inside out. You may activate the Melta Trait of any weapons you wield at Medium and Long Range (not just Short Range), and gain +Double Rank ED when making attacks with those weapons.

note: Also Apocrypha p.149.

name: Howling Banshee
note: XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 68. Possible print error: SKILLS (Ballistic Skill 2, Stealth 1, Survival 2) are exactly the Ranger's (p.23), and the Suggested Skills rate neither Stealth nor Survival. Also Apocrypha p.152.

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.text: You are a shock assault specialist, delivering such a devastating first strike your enemies are left reeling. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on melee attacks and Interaction Attacks made as part of a Charge.

name: Striking Scorpion

abilities.name: Stalking Shadow
abilities.text: You temper your lust to kill by silently hunting your prey first. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice and +Double Rank ED when making a Surprise Attack (in addition to the usual +2 bonus dice and +2 ED).

note: Also Apocrypha p.161.

name: Swooping Hawk

abilities.name: Skyleap
abilities.text: You employ hit-and-run manoeuvres to frustrate your enemies. You do not provoke Reflexive Attacks when you move out of Engagement. You also gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Pinning Attacks.

note: Also Apocrypha p.162.

name: Warp Spider

abilities.name: Flickerjump
abilities.text: You appear just long enough to weave a deadly web, before disappearing from sight. When an enemy enters Engagement with you whilst you are Unengaged, you may move up to your Speed as a Reflexive Action. You can use this ability up to Rank times per combat.

note: Also Apocrypha p.164.

name: Warlock
note: Suggested Psychic Powers cite "page 283/284" (Core's Runes of Battle pages); resolved to IoE's Runes of Battle records. The Universal Psyker Abilities (Core p.267) come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375). Also Core p.114.

abilities.name: Runes of Battle
abilities.text: You are a warrior and a Psyker both, adapting your powers to either augment your allies or assail your enemies. You know the Universal Psyker Abilities (Wrath & Glory page 267), the Smite psychic power, and a single power of your choice from the Runes of Battle Discipline.

name: Wraithguard

abilities.name: War Construct
abilities.text: Your new body weathers the strains of battle better than any living creature could. Any ranged weapons you wield without the Heavy Trait gain the Pistol Trait. When wielding two melee weapons, you reduce the DN penalty for making Multi-Attacks by 2. You gain +Rank Determination.

note: Also Apocrypha p.209.

name: Autarch
note: Print error: the Suggested Talents are printed under the heading "SUGGESTED PSYCHIC POWERS"; they are talents and are transcribed as talentIds. Also Apocrypha p.194.

abilities.name: Superlative Strategist
abilities.text: When you, or any allies within communication range, spend Glory to increase their dice pool, they gain +Rank bonus dice (in addition to bonus dice equal to the Glory spent). You may make Leadership Tests to remove the Fear, Terror, or Pinned Conditions as a Simple Action.

name: Farseer
note: Print error: Suggested Psychic Powers prints only "TBD", so powerIds is empty. The ability's two-power choice is from the Divination, Runes of Fate and Runes of Fortune disciplines; those also hold Apocrypha homebrew powers (Eldritch Storm, and Divination's Auto-Seance and others), which the builder hides as homebrew. The Universal Psyker Abilities (Core p.267) come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375).

abilities.name: The Witch Path
abilities.text: You are a supremely powerful Psyker, specialising in manipulation of the future. You know the Universal Psyker Abilities (Wrath & Glory page 267), and the Smite psychic power. You may choose two powers you know from any of the following Disciplines (so long as you meet the prerequisites): Divination, Runes of Fate, Runes of Fortune.

name: Kabalite Warrior

abilities.name: Prey on the Weak
abilities.text: Your mind is focussed by the scent of fear and suffering. You gain +Rank bonus dice on attack Tests against enemies that have suffered Wounds, or Mobs of Troops that have suffered casualties.

note: Also Apocrypha p.87.

name: Wych

abilities.name: Lightning Dodge
abilities.text: You run circles around your enemy, and take them apart one slice at a time. When wearing no armour besides a Wychsuit, you gain +Rank Defence against melee attacks.

note: Also Apocrypha p.97.

name: Hellion
note: IoE prints no Influence for this Archetype.

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.text: You revel in the confusion of swift attacks, striking fast before sweeping away from victims who fall prey to your Skyboard or Hellglaive. You do not provoke Reflexive Attacks when you move out of Engagement. You gain +Rank bonus dice on any Pilot (A) Tests related to the operation of your Skyboard.

name: Beastmaster
note: Suggested Talents print "Animal Companion [Khymera or Clawed Fiend]" and "Devotees [Razorwing Flock]".

abilities.name: Beast Handler
abilities.text: You command respect from wild animals, cowing them into obedience. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on all social Skill Tests against a creature with the BEAST Keyword. When you consent, allied BEAST creatures in communication range can spend your Wrath Points as their own.

name: Incubus
note: Printed in the Drukhari Archetypes section with the BLADES FOR HIRE keyword; filed under the drukhari faction. SKILLS prints "Intimidate 2"; transcribed as Intimidation. Also Apocrypha p.153.

abilities.name: Lethal Precision
abilities.text: You train tirelessly to master the perfect killing strike. When you inflict a Critical Hit on a melee attack, you inflict +Double Rank Mortal Wounds.

name: Mandrake
note: Printed in the Drukhari Archetypes section with the BLADES FOR HIRE keyword; filed under the drukhari faction. No Influence printed.

abilities.name: Shadow Creature
abilities.text: You are not a creature of flesh and blood, instead dwelling in a liminal state between realities. When you are not wearing armour, you gain +Rank Resilience, and can roll Determination against attacks that inflict Mortal Wounds. You always count as being in heavy fog, with all corresponding vision penalties (+3 DN to target with Awareness and Ballistic Skill Tests, +2 DN to target with Weapon Skill Tests). When you move, you ignore all obstacles between your start and end point, so long as you move from one shadow to another.

name: Scourge
note: Printed in the Drukhari Archetypes section with the BLADES FOR HIRE keyword; filed under the drukhari faction. Also Apocrypha p.127.

abilities.name: Winged Strike
abilities.text: You are grafted with wings that allow you to fly at double your normal Speed. More complicated aerial manoeuvres may require an Athletics (S) Test, with +Double Rank bonus dice. In addition, you can spend Shifts on a successful ranged attack Test to inflict the Pinned Condition on the target. This costs a number of Shifts equal to the target’s Resolve minus Rank.

name: Archon

abilities.name: Overlord
abilities.text: You drive your underlings toward success by threatening them with the consequences of failure. As a Simple Action, you may spend 1 Wrath to provide yourself and all allies +Rank bonus dice to the next Test they make this encounter in your presence. In addition, you may spend 1 Glory to gain 1 Wrath Point as a Free Action, up to Rank times per session.

note: Suggested talent printed "Supreme Presence [Intimidation]". Also Apocrypha p.193.

name: Haemonculus
note: Suggested talents cite Beyond Mortality as "page 61"; it is on p.60 (the Archon and Succubus entries cite page 60). Also Apocrypha p.199.

abilities.name: Master of Pain
abilities.text: You have inflicted such violations upon your own flesh that enemy attacks are barely cause for concern. You gain +Rank Resilience. In addition, when you heal another creature’s Wounds, you can choose to heal additional Wounds by inflicting an equal amount of Shock on the patient, up to Double Rank.

name: Succubus

abilities.name: Brides of Death
abilities.text: You shock your fellow warriors into greater acts of spectacular slaughter. Once per Turn as a Free Action, you may spend 1 Wrath to provide yourself and all allies in communication range +Rank ED on any melee attacks made until the start of your next Turn. When wearing no armour besides a Wychsuit, you gain +Rank Defence against ranged attacks.

note: Also Apocrypha p.204.

name: Troupe Player
note: Species printed "Aeldari/Drukhari". Also Apocrypha p.172.

abilities.name: War Dancer
abilities.text: You fight best as part of a chorus, the strikes of your allies blurring into your own as a storm of blades. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on melee attacks against an enemy engaged with an ally.

name: Death Jester
note: Species printed "Aeldari/Drukhari". Also Apocrypha p.200.

abilities.name: Death Is Not Enough
abilities.text: You delight in brutal volleys of firepower that demoralise and terrify your enemies. When you succeed on a ranged attack, any targets of the attack must make a Fear Test, with a DN of 1 + Double Rank. If none of your targets survived the attack, you can choose another character who witnessed the attack to make the Fear Test instead.

name: Shadowseer
note: Species printed "Aeldari/Drukhari". The Universal Psyker Abilities (Core p.267) come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375). Also Apocrypha p.201.

abilities.name: Phantasmancer
abilities.text: You know the Universal Psyker Abilities (Wrath & Glory page 267), and the Smite psychic power. You may choose two powers you know from any of the following Disciplines (so long as you meet the prerequisites): Divination, Phantasmancy, Telepathy.

name: Troupe Master
note: Species printed "Aeldari/Drukhari". Also Apocrypha p.203.

abilities.name: Choreographer of War
abilities.text: When you, or any allies within communication range, spend Glory to increase damage, they inflict +Rank damage (in addition to +1 damage per Glory spent). In addition, you may Seize the Initiative without spending Glory, up to Rank times per combat.

name: Voidreaver
note: Species printed "Aeldari, Drukhari". No Influence printed. Ability text prints "lighting strike raids" (copied as printed). Wargear "Shuriken Rifle or Shuriken Pistol and Void Sabre" is read as (Rifle or Pistol) and Void Sabre; it could also mean Rifle, or Pistol and Void Sabre (the Guardian, p.22, prints the same shape meaning Catapult, or Pistol and Chainsword). Also Apocrypha p.94.

abilities.name: Raiders of the Void
abilities.text: You are a raider, experienced at operating in the vacuum of space. Used to zero gravity, and engaging in lighting strike raids, you use speed and guile to your advantage in battle. You gain +Rank bonus dice to melee or ranged attacks when you Seize the Initiative. You gain a further +1 die bonus if this ability is used when fighting in zero gravity.

name: Voidscarred
note: Species printed "Aeldari, Drukhari". No Influence printed. Wargear read as (Rifle or Pistol) and Void Sabre, as for the Voidreaver; it could also mean Rifle, or Pistol and Void Sabre. Also printed, as suggested loadouts for Advanced Character Creation: Special Weapon gunners take in addition either a Corsair Blaster, Shredder, Wraithcannon or Shuriken Cannon. A Starstorm Duellist takes an additional Fusion, Blast, or Splinter Pistol. A Kurnite Hunter may take a Faolchu pet. A Shade Runner replaces their weapons with a pair of Hekatarii Blades and a Shuriken Pistol, and gains a Blink Pack. Kurnathi may upgrade their Void Sabre to a Master Crafted Void Sabre. A Fate Dealer gains a Ranger Long Rifle and a Cameleoline Cloak.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Stars
abilities.text: Your training has prepared you for any battlefield. When you make a Critical Hit you may roll twice on the Critical Hit table and choose either result.

name: Soul Weaver & Wayseeker
note: XP printed "44" with "+20" beneath it (GitHub issue #2). The printed 44 is the ratings alone; 44 + 20 = 64, not 54, so here the mark is not the Archetype Ability's (Tier − 1) × 10. Species printed "Aeldari, Drukhari". No Influence printed. PSYKER comes from the ability, not the printed Keywords. The Universal Psyker Abilities (Core p.267) come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375). Suggested Psychic Powers are two sets, both in powerIds: "Way Seeker: Prescience, Protect/Jinx, Psychometry" and "Soul Weaver: Empower/Enervate, Embolden/Horrify, Enhance/Drain". Wargear "Corsair Sabre" is not in the catalogue (Void Sabre?). XP as printed: the total of "44+20" (GM ruling, docs/rules-flow.md §11.35).

abilities.name: Void Dreamer
abilities.text: You have the PSYKER Keyword, and are a Psyker. You know the Universal Psyker Abilities (Wrath & Glory page 267), and the Smite psychic power.

name: Felarch
note: XP printed "124" with "+20" beneath it (GitHub issue #2). The printed 124 is the ratings alone and 124 + 20 = 144, so the mark reads as the Archetype Ability's (Tier − 1) × 10. Species printed "Aeldari, Drukhari". No Influence printed. Wargear read as (Rifle or Pistol) and Master Crafted Void Sabre, as for the Voidreaver; it could also mean Rifle, or Pistol and Master Crafted Void Sabre. XP as printed: the total of "124+20" (GM ruling, docs/rules-flow.md §11.35).

abilities.name: Captain of the Stars
abilities.text: You and any allies within 20 metres of you that can see you may add +Double Rank bonus dice to Resolve Tests. You add +Double Rank bonus dice to any Intimidation (Wil) Tests, including Interaction Attacks.

name: Corsair Prince
note: Stat block headed "PRINCE". XP printed "180" with "+30" beneath it (GitHub issue #2). The printed 180 is the ratings alone and 180 + 30 = 210, so the mark reads as the Archetype Ability's (Tier − 1) × 10. Species printed "Aeldari, Drukhari". No Influence printed. Keywords printed "AELDARI, ASURYANI, [CRAFTWORLD]", copied as printed; likely an error for ANHRATHE, [COTERIE] (every other Corsair entry, and the ability refers to ANHRATHE). Attributes print "Intelligence 2" (Intellect). XP as printed: the total of "180+30" (GM ruling, docs/rules-flow.md §11.35).

abilities.name: Lord of the Galaxy
abilities.text: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to social Skill Tests when interacting with a character with the AELDARI or DRUKHARI Keywords. You gain +Double Rank bonus to all Cunning Tests when commanding ANHRATHE characters and units.
